name: prompt-to-ship
description: From prompt to shipped change, in any language and on any git host. Each request becomes a brief and a plan reviewed by a fixed architect and product expert, then is built with proof, reviewed in layers and delivered as a change request. Modes: debug shipped code, find your next step, review a screen, find hidden states, keep a project map, put a project online, draw verified diagrams. A built-in design skill checks every visible change. It never merges without your word by default.
